title: VTC Rooms Community Update — payload
description: Change the details an administrator keeps track of a community-owned room by — its label, its description, its tags — the room's signal delay, or the record members its profile lists. Each member given replaces the stored one; a member absent is unchanged. At least one detail is required (`minProperties` counts `roomId` and `reason`), `description` and `removeDescription` are mutually exclusive, as are `recordMembers` and `removeRecordMembers`. A changed label, description or record members is also re-written into the room's own profile, sealed inside the room for its members, through the community's VTA; tags never are. Only `signalDelay` reaches the room's host record; nothing here reaches any credential. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

label.description: The room's new name. Absent: unchanged.

description.description: The room's new description, replacing any it has. Absent: unchanged.

removeDescription.description: Remove the room's description. Only `true` is meaningful, so only `true` is accepted. A separate member rather than `description: null`, because a nullable optional member makes "unchanged" and "remove" the same value in libraries that map both to one absent option.

tags.description: The room's tags, replacing the whole set. An empty list removes them all. Absent: unchanged.

signalDelay.description: The room's new signal delay, as the community applies it as host to every `rooms/changed` signal it sends for the room from then on. Absent: unchanged.

recordMembers.description: The record members the room's profile is to list, replacing the whole set it lists now. Absent: whatever the profile lists is kept, including a set a member holding `curate` wrote there.

removeRecordMembers.description: Have the room's profile list no record members, so its writers stop using them by the room's next epoch at the latest; records already written keep them. Only `true` is meaningful. A separate member rather than an empty `recordMembers`, as `removeDescription` is, so "unchanged" and "remove" are never one value.

Response.title: VTC Rooms Community Update — response payload
Response.description: Success response to vtc/rooms/community/update. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/rooms/community/update/0.5#response. The room as it now stands, its signal delay, and whether this request changed either.

changed.description: `false` when every value given already matched what the room had, its signal delay included: nothing was written, `detailsUpdatedAt` and `detailsUpdatedBy` did not move, and no change was audited.

roomProfile.description: Whether the room's own profile — sealed inside the room for its members — now carries the new label, description and record members. `written`: it does. `pending`: the details changed and the profile has not yet been re-written — the room is lapsed, or its VTA or host did not answer, or refused — and the community will keep trying. `unchanged`: nothing the profile carries changed (only tags or the signal delay, or `changed: false`), so nothing was written.

signalDelay.description: The room's signal delay as it now stands. Always present.
